brief: A PLA hydra: a round base 40 mm across and 5 mm thick, with an upright pole 10 mm across and 80 mm tall standing on the middle of it. Six 4 mm rods, each 20 mm long, stick straight out sideways from the pole near its top, evenly spaced around it. It carries no load, so there is no load case.

intent.summary: A decorative/display PLA part ("hydra") consisting of a round base plate with a central vertical pole and six radial rods near the pole's top, explicitly stated to carry no load.
intent.part_kind: multi-feature printed fixture (base + pole + radial rods)
stated: Upright pole 10 mm diameter, 80 mm tall
Pole stands in the middle of the base
Six rods, 4 mm diameter, 20 mm long
Rods stick straight out sideways from the pole near its top
Rods are evenly spaced around the pole
It carries no load, so there is no load case
implied: Base is round and pole is centered, so the design is intended to be axisymmetric/rotationally balanced
Rods are 'near the top' and 'evenly spaced', implying a single horizontal ring with 60° angular spacing
PLA material implies FDM 3D printing as the manufacturing process
No load case implies strength/stress analysis is not required, only geometric buildability
unstated: Exact vertical position of the rod ring on the pole (how far below the top)
Whether rods are evenly spaced in a single plane or staggered helically
Fillet/joint geometry where rods meet the pole and where pole meets base (affects printability)
Whether the pole is solid or hollow
Whether the base has any mounting features (holes, feet) or is a flat disc
Orientation for printing (supports, overhangs) despite rods sticking out sideways
Whether the six rods are identical in length/diameter or could vary
Intended use/display context of the hydra (decorative only, or functional mount for something)
Any assembly or post-processing steps (e.g., gluing additional features)
out_of_scope: Selecting material grade or print settings
Performing structural analysis despite 'no load' statement
risk_signals: None identified: part explicitly stated to carry no load, is not described as supporting a person, lifting weight, holding pressure, storing energy, or part of a vehicle/regulated equipment

requirements.statement: The round base shall be 40 mm across.
The base shall be 5 mm thick.
The upright pole shall be 10 mm across.
The upright pole shall be 80 mm tall.
Each of the six radial rods shall be 4 mm across.
Each of the six radial rods shall be 20 mm long.
Six rods shall stick straight out sideways from the pole, evenly spaced around it.

assumptions.statement: The six radial rods are arranged in a single horizontal ring, centred about 10 mm below the top of the pole ('near its top').
assumptions.rationale: The brief says the rods stick out 'near its top' but gives no exact offset; a single ring close to the top is the natural reading of 'near the top' and 'evenly spaced around it'.
assumptions.consequence_if_wrong: If the rods were meant to be staggered at different heights or further from the top, the model's silhouette and balance would not match intent, though the part would still be buildable.

assumptions.statement: The six rods are spaced at equal 60 degree intervals around the pole's circumference, all in the same horizontal plane.
assumptions.rationale: 'Evenly spaced around it' for six identical rods in one ring implies 60 degree spacing; no alternative arrangement is stated.
assumptions.consequence_if_wrong: A helical or uneven arrangement would change the visual/structural layout, but this is a decorative part so impact is cosmetic only.

assumptions.statement: The pole and base are modelled as solid (not hollow) PLA, consistent with a simple decorative print.
assumptions.rationale: No wall thickness or hollow feature is mentioned in the brief.
assumptions.consequence_if_wrong: A hollow design would reduce material/print time but is not required for function since there is no load case.

assumptions.statement: The pole is centred on the base, both in plan position and concentric with the base's circular outline.
assumptions.rationale: The brief states the pole stands 'on the middle of it'.
assumptions.consequence_if_wrong: An off-centre pole would unbalance the part visually and structurally, but the brief is explicit about centring.

assumptions.statement: No fillets or blends are added at the pole/base or rod/pole junctions beyond what is needed for basic FDM printability; joints are modelled as simple intersections.
assumptions.rationale: The brief gives no fillet radii or joint treatment.
assumptions.consequence_if_wrong: Sharp internal junctions may be slightly weaker or harder to print cleanly, but since there is no load case this has no functional consequence.

assumptions.statement: The base is a plain flat disc with no additional mounting holes, feet, or features beyond the stated diameter and thickness.
assumptions.rationale: No such features are mentioned in the brief.
assumptions.consequence_if_wrong: If mounting features were intended, the part would need rework, but nothing in the brief suggests them.
